System architecture

Four-stage deterministic verification pipeline

Stage 010.04 ms · 0 tokens

Pre-inference gate

Diacritic-normalized TR/EN safety & policy rules short-circuit high-risk inputs before any model call.

Stage 02vLLM · SGLang · API

Model runtime

Vendor-neutral generation over open-weight GPU clusters or commercial JSON-mode endpoints.

Stage 030.09 ms · fail-closed

Schema & <think> filter

Strips reasoning traces and markdown fences; enforces typed bounds and required fields.

Stage 040.14 ms · exact slice

1:1 span provenance

Maps folded codepoints back to [start_char, end_char) in retrieved chunks; strips ungrounded quotes.

Verified production traces (curated examples)

See how Yankı audits real model outputs.

Select a scenario below to inspect the source context, the raw unverified model draft, and Yankı's deterministic verification output. No live model call is made in the browser.

Regulated Banking Policy RAG (Turkish U+0130 Offset Preservation)

Python's native `'İSTANBUL'.lower()` expands U+0130 to 2 codepoints and shifts every subsequent slice by +1/+2 chars. Yankı's 1-to-1 codepoint folder recovers the exact `[0, 50)` source slice.

VERIFIED EXACT · 0.14 ms
01 · Retrieved source chunk (doc_id: bddk_2026_04)
doc_id = "bddk_2026_04"
source = (
  "İSTANBUL veri merkezinde tutulan birincil yedekler, "
  "her iş günü 23:00 itibarıyla Ankara bölgesine çoğaltılır."
)
02 · Unverified model draft (lowercased & diacritic-drifted quote)

    "doc_id": "bddk_2026_04",
    "quote": "istanbul veri merkezinde tutulan birincil yedekler"
  }]
}

Multi-Document Enterprise SLA Synthesis (Cross-Chunk Fabrication)

Models frequently merge clauses from two separate retrieved documents into a single plausible-sounding fabricated quote. `verify_multi_source_citations` detects the non-contiguous stitch and strips the quote before delivery.

UNGROUNDED STRIPPED · 0.21 ms
01 · Retrieved chunks (sla_v4 + postmortem_v2)
chunks = {
  "sla_v4": "Enterprise incidents receive a 15-minute triage response.",
  "postmortem_v2": "Root-cause reports are delivered within five business days."
}
02 · Unverified model draft (stitched hallucinated quote)
{
  "answer": "Enterprise incidents get a 15-minute root-cause report.",
  "citations": [{
    "doc_id": "sla_v4",
    "quote": "Enterprise incidents receive a 15-minute root-cause report."
  }]
}
03 · Yankı deterministic audit output
{
  "grounded": false,
  "match_kind": "ungrounded_paraphrase",
  "token_overlap": 0.62,
  "verified_quote": null,
  "action": "quote_stripped_and_flagged",
  "latency_ms": 0.21
}

Open-Weight Reasoning Model on vLLM (<think> Extraction & Bounds)

Open-weight reasoning models emit verbose `<think>...</think>` traces and markdown fences before JSON. `yanki.schema` isolates the structured object, prevents internal chain-of-thought leakage, and enforces strict field invariants.

CONTRACT VALIDATED · 0.09 ms
01 · Source passage (incident_note_19)
source = (
  "We shipped the index migration on schedule, "
  "yet latency spiked on shard three after midnight."
)
02 · Raw vLLM completion with <think> trace
<think>
User describes mixed relief and concern about shard three...
</think>
```json
{
  "duygu": "uneasy",
  "siddet": 3,
  "yansitma": "Shipping on time met the goal, while shard three still needs attention.",
  "alinti": "latency spiked on shard three after midnight",
  "adim": "Inspect shard three slow-query logs for the 00:00 window."
}
```
03 · Yankı deterministic audit output
{
  "schema_valid": true,
  "think_trace_stripped": true,
  "siddet": 3,
  "alinti_verified": "latency spiked on shard three after midnight",
  "span": [48, 92],
  "latency_ms": 0.09
}

Pre-Inference Safety & Policy Short-Circuit (Zero LLM Invocation)

High-risk inputs—including diacritic-stripped Turkish or English safety/compliance triggers—must never depend on probabilistic model refusal. `yanki.guardrails` intercepts them deterministically before any network request is made.

SHORT-CIRCUITED · 0.04 ms
01 · Incoming request (high-risk guardrail trigger)
payload = {"text": "<safety-critical-or-regulated-trigger>", "lang": "tr"}
# Evaluated locally via normalized TR/EN rule pack before HTTP dispatch
02 · Model runtime invocation
// SKIPPED — no HTTP call issued to vLLM or external API
// tokens_prompt: 0 | tokens_completion: 0
03 · Yankı deterministic audit output
{
  "guardrail_triggered": true,
  "llm_invoked": false,
  "rule_pack": "guardrail-tr-en-v2",
  "safe_routing": "Deterministic safe response returned without model call",
  "latency_ms": 0.04
}

Open-source core · Available today (MIT)

Inside the yanki 0.2.0 Python package.

While the hosted multi-tenant console is in development, the complete deterministic verification engine ships today as a clean, dependency-free Python 3.11+ library (`src/yanki/`) with full unit tests and GPU cluster recipes.

01 · yanki.normalize

Index-preserving Unicode folding

1-to-1 codepoint folding for Turkish `İ/ı` and diacritics (`ğ, ü, ş, ö, ç`) with explicit source offset arrays so normalized substring hits slice cleanly into raw documents.

02 · yanki.grounding

Single- & multi-source RAG citation audit

`verify_quote_grounding` and `verify_multi_source_citations` validate every model quote against retrieved chunk IDs, returning `[start_char, end_char)` provenance or stripping hallucinations.

03 · yanki.guardrails & schema

Pre-inference safety & <think>-aware JSON

Deterministic sub-millisecond safety short-circuit before LLM invocation, paired with strict typed JSON extraction that strips reasoning `<think>...</think>` traces safely.

04 · yanki.providers & hpc/

vLLM, SGLang, OpenAI-compatible & Slurm

Vendor-neutral zero-SDK evaluation client for OpenAI-compatible GPU servers (`vLLM`, `SGLang`) and HTTP APIs, shipped with `Apptainer` CUDA definitions and `Slurm` scripts.

Reproducible benchmark suite

24/24 deterministic test cases across Turkish & English.

Executed automatically on every commit in GitHub Actions CI across Python 3.11 and 3.12 (`python -m yanki.eval --offline --strict-thresholds`).
